verdict.rationale: doola's Partner API exposes a per-company compliance calendar listing the recurring obligations doola tracks to keep the entity in good standing. An agent can poll it to see upcoming deadlines, then act on them through the annual-report filing endpoints (submit, confirm, follow to completion). Signed webhooks exist, but they are only documented for formation and EIN milestones. missing for 10: an explicit entity good-standing status field or endpoint, documented webhook events for upcoming or lapsing compliance deadlines, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the calendar API.
